evidence_restriction: Public --describe-spec and annotated-matrix reference only; implementation/tests/other evaluation outputs not inspected
inspection_scope: Actual PNG reduction at final physical size and 96 dpi
Actual PDF rendered by Poppler at 96 dpi
Actual SVG rendered by librsvg at 96 dpi
findings: All seven literal vessel IDs and six literal challenge IDs remain readable and uncut.
Metadata strips align by exact IDs despite deliberately shuffled metadata input records.
The observed zero remains quantitative, explicit unmeasured has cross hatch, and the absent unsupplied coordinate has plus hatch; keys remain distinguishable.
Row mean bars include negative values and align to all seven matrix rows. Independently recomputed means and omission denominators match.
The explicit constructed column tree retains the declared leaf order and heights.
Colorbar, category keys and missing-state guides are decoded without overlap.
No in-image narrative title or significance layer was added.
residual_issues: The combined guide envelope is 0.548 of the matrix plot envelope. Six necessary keys make a relatively large right guide column; it fits and remains readable, but no aesthetic improvement is claimed.
SVG rasterization at 96 dpi shows faint per-cell edge seams; numeric/source audit and vector cell geometry remain correct.
